item.title: QAD ERP Reporting Extends to Microsoft Fabric via Open Mirroring
item.description:
QAD ERP Reporting Extends to Microsoft Fabric via Open Mirroring

Manufacturers using QAD ERP can combine multiple reporting layers, and a new mirroring path now moves QAD data into Microsoft Fabric.

🔍 Overview

  • Layer 1 – Native QAD tools – Provide operational lookups, formatted documents and financial statements inside the ERP.
  • Layer 2 – Power BI – Adds interactive analysis; the simplest connection imports QAD data over OpenEdge ODBC on a schedule.
  • Layer 3 – Data warehouse / Microsoft Fabric – Uses a QAD Fabric mirroring process that runs through Open Mirroring because Microsoft Fabric has no native mirroring source for QAD.

🧩 How it works

  1. An extraction layer reads tables from the Progress OpenEdge database behind QAD.
  2. It writes those tables as Parquet files into a landing zone in OneLake.
  3. Microsoft Fabric turns the Parquet files into Delta tables and keeps them current.
  4. Each table requires a stable key.

⚙️ Key details

  • The three layers can be used simultaneously by a manufacturer.
  • Power BI connects via OpenEdge ODBC and can be scheduled for regular imports.
  • Fabric mirroring relies on Open Mirroring; there is no built‑in source connector for QAD.
  • Delta tables in Fabric provide a continuously refreshed view of the ERP data.

📊 Layer comparison

Layer What it provides Integration method
Native QAD tools Operational lookups, formatted documents, financial statements Built‑in ERP functionality
Power BI Interactive analysis OpenEdge ODBC import on a schedule
Microsoft Fabric Mirrored, current Delta tables Open Mirroring → Parquet → OneLake → Delta

💡 Why it matters

  • Combining native ERP reports with Power BI and Fabric gives manufacturers flexible, up‑to‑date analytics.
  • The mirroring flow keeps the data warehouse synchronized without a native QAD connector.
  • Stable keys ensure reliable table joins and updates within Fabric.

item.title: Urgent Search Launched for Power Platform Administrator in Manchester IT Hub
item.description:
Urgent Search Launched for Power Platform Administrator in Manchester IT Hub

A blue-chip client has launched an urgent recruitment drive for a Power Platform Administrator to support its operations in Manchester or Inverness. Managed through a preferred supplier, this contract role represents a key technical opening within Manchester’s technology sector, which encompasses fintech, software, data engineering, and enterprise IT.

🔍 Overview

The newly opened contract position is an onsite role requiring five days per week of office-based work. The position operates under PAYE via an umbrella company, with immediate interviews available for qualified candidates.

⚙️ Key details

The contract features specific operational parameters and structural requirements:

  • Locations: Onsite in Manchester or Inverness.
  • Attendance: Mandatory five days per week onsite (100% office-based).
  • Service Window: A 12-hour service window from 07:00 to 19:00 UK time (08:00 to 20:00 CET).
  • Payment Status: PAYE via an umbrella company only.

🧩 How it works

The Power Platform Administrator will be responsible for maintaining the health, security, and compliance of the organization’s data tools. Key responsibilities include:

  • Administering and maintaining the Power BI Service, Workspaces, Apps, and Dataflows.
  • Managing tenant settings, user access, workspace permissions, and security controls.
  • Enforcing Power BI governance standards, compliance requirements, and reporting certification processes.
  • Monitoring platform health, capacity utilization, refresh schedules, usage metrics, and audit logs.
  • Managing gateways and data source connectivity while troubleshooting performance and refresh issues.
  • Maintaining technical documentation and collaborating with business and technical stakeholders to ensure platform adoption and best practices.

To qualify for the position, candidates must demonstrate the following skills:

  • Strong knowledge of Power BI Service administration and governance for both Cloud and Reporting Server.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), access management, and security configuration.
  • Knowledge of enterprise governance, compliance, and audit requirements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

🚀 Availability

This position is currently open for applications, with immediate interviews being scheduled. Candidates can apply by submitting their CV directly to the preferred supplier. Additionally, IT professionals looking to navigate Manchester’s digital innovation hub can utilize the IT Job Board to search permanent, contract, hybrid, and remote opportunities, upload CVs, set preference filters, and sign up for personalized job alerts.
